about_short_description.short_description: Wafeq is a software that provides accounting and e-invoicing solutions for business owners and accountants.

product.name: Accounting and Invoicing Software
product.description: A cloud-based software for managing accounting, invoicing, purchase orders, inventory, payroll, and financial reporting for businesses and accountants.

product.name: Payroll and Employee Expense Management
product.description: A module to manage employee payroll processing and streamline employee expense claims within the accounting system.

product.name: VAT Return Automation
product.description: Automated generation of VAT returns formatted according to tax authority requirements for easy submission.

product.name: Inventory and Product/Service Management
product.description: Automatic tracking and management of product and service inventory linked to invoicing and sales.

product.name: Supplier and Customer Contact Management
product.description: A contact management system to maintain and use lists of customers and suppliers for invoicing and purchasing.

product.name: Financial Reporting and Analytics
product.description: Generation of comprehensive financial reports including profit and loss, cash flow forecasts, sales, purchases, and consolidated statements.
